external_calls.provider: Speechmatics, Soniox, AssemblyAI and Deepgram Nova-3
external_calls.data_scope: One external-real streaming call per provider using only locally generated synthetic 16 kHz PCM speech; no customer audio, credentials, Bot data or unrelated content; maximum 60 seconds submitted per provider.
external_calls.cost_ceiling: USD 1 total across all four calls
external_calls.stop_condition: Under D-018, diagnose and apply a targeted local fix after each failure before retrying; at most five additional retries total, no blind automatic retry, and stop before cumulative cost exceeds USD 1.
external_calls.status: Completed within D-018 bounds. Speechmatics passed on attempt 4 (retry 3 of 5); Soniox passed on attempt 2 (retry 4 of 5); Deepgram Nova-3 passed its first call with ar-SA and one speech_final-derived Turn; AssemblyAI Universal-3.5 Pro passed its first call with one Final, one downstream Turn and context_applied=true. Estimated cumulative public-list cost is below USD 0.004.

known_issues.summary: Prototype browser validation could not launch Chromium inside the restricted sandbox because macOS denied the browser rendezvous port; retry requires the approved unsandboxed browser process.
known_issues.resolution: Approved unsandboxed Chromium run succeeded for desktop visual capture and desktop/narrow interaction checks.

known_issues.summary: Draft prototype used a flat Provider card grid, modeled AssemblyAI language as a single select, and omitted or simplified provider-specific Advanced parameters, diverging from the existing Deepgram UI and current provider contracts.
known_issues.resolution: Replaced the card grid with a provider dropdown, modeled AssemblyAI language_codes as an optional 18-language multi-select steering list, restored the existing Deepgram Advanced field order, and added provider-specific Speechmatics, Soniox, and AssemblyAI fields. Headless Chromium verified all four provider states, 18 AssemblyAI options, unified/native switching, and zero horizontal overflow at 1440×1000 and 390×844.

known_issues.summary: The draft ASR prototype placed credentials before Advanced and invented separate 'Use saved key' and 'Save encrypted key' actions, diverging from the current Bot editor's credential ordering and blank-means-keep saved-key interaction.
known_issues.resolution: Moved Provider credentials after Advanced; restored the current password input, Show action, and Save API key switch pattern; removed Use saved key; added blank-means-keep global Connection status. Chromium verified ordering, four-provider status switching, Show/save interaction, and zero horizontal overflow at desktop and narrow viewports.

known_issues.summary: One PRD branch-flow bullet still referenced closed question Q-003 after the global Provider Connection decision was synchronized.
known_issues.resolution: Replaced the stale Q-003 marker with the confirmed global Connection switching and missing-key behavior.

known_issues.summary: The shared two-column base-form grid stretched the Model field to match the taller Audio input help block, making the Model select oversized for all four providers.
known_issues.resolution: Top-aligned the shared two-column grid and field content. Chromium at 1354×984 measured every provider Model select at 41 px, with zero horizontal overflow.

known_issues.summary: The Speechmatics language control hard-coded four illustrative values and described Enhanced with the legacy operating_point wording instead of using the current Language Pack Catalog and model=enhanced contract.
known_issues.resolution: Replaced the sample list with all 62 language packs returned by the current Speechmatics Feature Discovery metadata, defaulted the prototype to ar_en, excluded Batch-only auto from Realtime, linked Domain options to the selected pack, and corrected the Enhanced contract to model=enhanced. Chromium at 1354×984 verified the pack list, required multilingual codes, domain linkage, summary updates, and zero horizontal overflow.

known_issues.summary: The Soniox Language hints '+ Add hint' control was a non-functional visual placeholder and did not identify whether values were free text or catalog selections, nor their source.
known_issues.resolution: Replaced the placeholder with a searchable multi-select backed by a 60-language fixture matching Soniox GET /v1/models stt-rt-v5.languages[]. The prototype supports add, chip removal, clear-to-automatic, rejects custom codes by design, updates the ASR summary, and identifies the source. Chromium verified all 60 options, search, add/remove/clear states, and zero horizontal overflow at 1354×984 and 390×844.

known_issues.summary: The PRD contained stale drawer hierarchy copy that placed API Key in the basic section and described Advanced as collapsed, and it did not fully distinguish prototype review fixtures from product defaults for provider-specific controls.
known_issues.resolution: PRD V1.0.10 now mirrors the prototype hierarchy, places global Provider credentials after Advanced, and labels displayed values as review fixtures rather than production defaults.

known_issues.summary: The prototype and Change artifacts exposed VoiceAgent unified Turn Detection as a current selectable mode, while the product now supports only Provider native and Off; Self-developed Turn Detection is future scope.
known_issues.resolution: Removed VoiceAgent unified from the active PRD, proposal, design, Delta Specs, tasks, prototype and Gate/UI review artifacts. The only current source values are Provider native and Off; the superseded D-003 remains solely as historical decision evidence.

known_issues.summary: The AssemblyAI Universal-3.5 Pro prototype and PRD exposed format_turns even though current official guidance states formatting is integral to the model's punctuation-based turn detection and format_turns is not applicable.
known_issues.resolution: Removed format_turns as a configurable field and replaced it with a non-interactive formatting-always-on explanation in the prototype, PRD and provider contract.

known_issues.summary: The Deepgram design and prototype exposed only Flux and would have incorrectly reused Flux V2 EOT and language_hint fields if Nova-3 were added without a separate V1 Streaming parameter contract.
known_issues.resolution: Added a separate Nova-3 V1 model branch with a 105-value current Models & Languages Catalog fixture and endpointing/interim/utterance/VAD/keyterm/formatting/output controls. Flux retains its independent V2 model-native EOT branch. Browser interaction verified branch replacement, disabled unusable Off, 41 px model control, no script errors and zero desktop/narrow overflow.

known_issues.summary: The corrected prototype still mislabeled Deepgram Nova-3 V1 silence endpointing as a selectable Provider-native Turn Detection source and duplicated that explanation in Advanced; product direction requires Nova-3 to be Off-only and Soniox to be Provider-native-only.
known_issues.resolution: Nova-3 now selects Off by default and Soniox selects Provider native. The earlier Speechmatics threshold=0 and removal of Nova endpointing were subsequently identified as an incorrect interpretation of Off and are superseded by KI-013/D-012.

known_issues.summary: The Change incorrectly defined Turn Detection Off as disabling every automatic turn boundary, mapping Speechmatics to end_of_utterance_silence_trigger=0 and Nova-3 to endpointing=false. The product definition is to disable semantic/acoustic turn intelligence while retaining VAD/fixed-silence endpointing.
known_issues.resolution: Recorded D-012 and synchronized PRD V1.0.12, proposal, design, Delta Specs, tasks, prototype and UI evidence. Speechmatics Off now locks FIXED with a positive silence trigger; Nova-3 Off exposes positive V1 endpointing; AssemblyAI and Soniox keep Off disabled because no Provider-side VAD-only automatic boundary is available in this scope. Chromium verified desktop and narrow interaction states with zero horizontal overflow.

known_issues.summary: The AssemblyAI prototype supplies a mode preset and explicit min/max turn silence plus interruption-delay values at the same time. Explicit fine-grained values override preset behavior, so a mid-stream mode update may not produce the full selected preset.
known_issues.resolution: D-013 defines deterministic preset-plus-edit behavior: every Mode selection atomically resets and populates min_turn_silence, max_turn_silence and interruption_delay; manual changes mark the Mode modified, and runtime submits the Mode plus all three final explicit values together.

known_issues.summary: The Speechmatics prototype did not expose the real contract for sentence emission, maximum EOU delay, or punctuation marks: split_sentences is a Voice SDK segmentation mapping rather than a wire field, maximum EOU delay omitted its 10.0-second default and relational constraint, and permitted_marks used an ambiguous raw 'all' text input.
known_issues.resolution: Updated PRD V1.0.13, Delta Spec, design, tasks and prototype. Sentence emission is labeled as the Voice SDK segment mapping and explicitly separated from EndOfTurn; Maximum EOU shows the 10.0-second SDK default with a dynamic lower bound; permitted marks uses All-supported by default or a custom one-character-per-line list. Desktop and 390 px Chromium checks passed with no script errors or horizontal overflow.

known_issues.summary: The official Pipecat Speechmatics adapter in the project-locked pipecat-ai==1.8.1 package appears to assign split_sentences directly onto VoiceAgentConfig before applying the correct speech_segment_config.emit_sentences mapping. This is an upstream-adapter compatibility risk, not a confirmed Speechmatics server defect: the top-level assignment may be rejected locally before connection. Prevention is mandatory before shipment: run a no-key config-construction test; if needed, bypass the invalid assignment in the VoiceAgent thin adapter and construct SpeechSegmentConfig explicitly; prove with mock frames that AddSegment only accumulates text and only EndOfTurn submits one LLM turn; then perform an explicitly authorized external-real stream test.
known_issues.resolution: Installed the user-authorized locked Speechmatics extra, reproduced the upstream local failure (`VoiceAgentConfig` rejects top-level split_sentences), added a thin subclass that omits the invalid assignment and constructs SpeechSegmentConfig explicitly, and added no-network tests proving sentence AddSegment frames do not propose Turn end while one EndOfTurn emits exactly one stop proposal. External-real verification remains tracked separately in UV-001.

known_issues.summary: The first headless Chromium validation of the revised Speechmatics prototype was blocked by the macOS sandbox denying Chromium's rendezvous port.
known_issues.resolution: The approved unsandboxed Chromium retry completed successfully at desktop and 390 px narrow viewports.

known_issues.summary: Prototype button-based switches were allowed to flex-shrink inside long switch-row copy, collapsing the Emit completed sentences control into a small circle and diverging from the current product's 34 x 20 px switch style.
known_issues.resolution: Matched the current product switch geometry and colors, added a fixed 34 x 20 px flex basis plus focus-visible styling, and let copy consume the remaining width. Chromium verified every visible switch across all four Providers at 34 x 20 px, correct on/off clicks, no script errors, and zero horizontal overflow at 1278 x 1104 and 390 x 844.

known_issues.summary: The first headless Chromium validation of the AssemblyAI Mode preset interaction was blocked by the macOS sandbox denying Chromium's rendezvous port.
known_issues.resolution: The approved unsandboxed Chromium retry verified preset population, manual-modification state, and zero horizontal overflow at 1278 x 1104 and 390 x 844.

known_issues.summary: The planning artifacts understated the decision count as 12 after D-013 was added, and the PRD incorrectly said no confirmation blocked development even though User Gate 1 and the prototype baseline were still pending.
known_issues.resolution: Updated the decision metadata to 13 decisions with the correct review date and made the pending User Gate 1 confirmation explicit in the PRD without changing product behavior.

known_issues.summary: Targeted API test collection is blocked because src/evaluation/prompts.py still reads prompt fixtures from the removed openspec/changes/add-asr-automated-evaluation path, while those artifacts now exist under the archive path.
known_issues.resolution: Updated the runtime fixture root to the archived Change path and verified API test collection proceeds past prompt loading.

known_issues.summary: The first implementation of AssemblyAIOptions represented Voice Focus as a boolean and always supplied a numeric threshold, while the frozen baseline and Pipecat provider contract require Off/near-field/far-field and omit the threshold unless focus is enabled.
known_issues.resolution: Changed voice_focus to the provider enum or null, made the threshold nullable, rejected threshold-without-mode, and bounded interruption_delay to the provider's documented 0-1000 ms range.

known_issues.summary: The frozen Gate 1 baseline specified global component/provider credentials, but the product owner clarified that this release should keep credentials inside each Bot and defer reusable resources to a future resource-management page.
known_issues.resolution: Recorded D-015, removed Q-006, and synchronized the PRD, proposal, design, Delta Spec, tasks, prototype and verification wording to Bot-scoped component/provider credentials. A refreshed prototype checksum and targeted browser evidence remain part of the baseline amendment work.

known_issues.summary: The first production UI Playwright run could not launch Chromium inside the restricted sandbox because macOS denied the browser rendezvous port; all cases failed before page execution.
known_issues.resolution: The approved unsandboxed Chromium process launched successfully and reached the formal production route; subsequent failures were actionable UI/test findings rather than browser startup failures.

known_issues.summary: At the required 390 px viewport, the fixed Bot configuration panel covered the formal settings route and prevented component-card interaction; the Soniox Clear all action also inherited global absolute positioning and could sit beneath the sticky drawer header.
known_issues.resolution: Made the Bot panel participate in narrow document flow, constrained the drawer to the remaining viewport beside the product rail, and scoped the language Clear all action back to static flow. All 16 desktop/390 px Voice Bot UI tests now pass with no drawer overflow.

known_issues.summary: Pipecat 1.8.1 DeepgramSTTService emits Nova-3 final transcript frames but does not convert the provider's speech_final=true event into a final Turn proposal; without a thin mapping, Nova-3 can transcribe text without triggering the LLM.
known_issues.resolution: Added a Nova-3 thin adapter that ignores ordinary is_final chunks, emits one final Turn proposal for speech_final=true, and deduplicates a repeated provider event. The no-network regression test passes.

known_issues.summary: Pipecat 1.8.1 AssemblyAI update_agent_context silently no-ops when disconnected and swallows UpdateConfiguration send errors, so the first bridge implementation could incorrectly record context_applied=true.
known_issues.resolution: Added an observable thin adapter that requires an open socket and propagates send failure into the non-blocking bridge. Turn history now stores context_applied and a safe failure category; local success, disconnected failure, concurrency, and failure-containment tests pass.

known_issues.summary: The default mypy run uses the project's Python 3.11 target while the active virtualenv is Python 3.13 and contains a NumPy stub with Python 3.12+ type-statement syntax, so collection stops in site-packages before project code is checked.
known_issues.resolution: Created an isolated Python 3.11 environment from the project lock, then verified mypy across all 46 source files and reran all 338 tests successfully under the CI runtime. The active Python 3.13 environment also passes all 338 tests and a Python-3.13 mypy run.

known_issues.summary: The first full frontend regression run reported 11 failures outside the Voice Bot scope because the local server did not provide the legacy auth/evaluation suite's acceptance account and isolated database, and changing the shared narrow project to 390 px exposed unrelated Evaluation-page assumptions.
known_issues.resolution: Restored the repository's shared narrow project to 1024 px and moved the required 390 px viewport into this Change's scoped provider test. Both Voice Bot projects pass all 16 tests. The remaining 10 full-suite failures are isolated to legacy Auth/Evaluation acceptance state under the ad-hoc server and are documented in the UI checklist rather than treated as this Change's product regression.

known_issues.summary: After D-015 amended credentials to Bot scope, Gate records still contained the superseded D-014 prototype checksum and the PRD header remained V1.0.14, creating multiple apparent active baselines.
known_issues.resolution: Synchronized the then-current D-015 baseline; that historical checksum was explicitly superseded by the confirmed D-019/D-020 amendment, whose sole active value is recorded in prototypes/README.md.

known_issues.summary: Independent verification reproduced that BotUpdateRequest and the production save flow still require ASR, TTS and LLM keys to be replaced together, so changing only the current Bot's ASR provider cannot preserve its existing TTS/LLM keys while saving the new ASR key. This violates D-015 component/provider-scoped credential replacement.
known_issues.resolution: Bot credentials now persist and replace independently per ASR/TTS/LLM component; targeted Bot API regression proves an ASR provider/key change preserves the TTS and LLM ciphertexts.

known_issues.summary: The production /api/catalogs path returns hard-coded Speechmatics Language Pack and Soniox language fixtures. It does not filter Speechmatics packs by the current Bot account or fetch and normalize Soniox GET /v1/models, even though the response labels those values account_filtered/source-backed. This proves Checkpoint A fixture behavior but not the frozen real Catalog contract required for Checkpoint B.
known_issues.resolution: Bundled values are now honestly labeled snapshots, and POST /api/asr/catalog performs explicit authenticated Speechmatics Feature Discovery or Soniox GET /v1/models normalization with a 10-second timeout; mock transport tests cover both shapes.

known_issues.summary: The confirmed D-005 ASRService boundary is absent: ASRProviderRegistry returns Pipecat STTService objects directly, and run_voice_agent_session probes the provider-specific update_agent_context method and agent_context_enabled option itself. Provider Context capability therefore leaks into Pipeline orchestration instead of flowing through a public ASRService control contract.
known_issues.resolution: ASRProviderRegistry now returns the public ASRService wrapper; Pipeline consumes only processor and provider-neutral context capability methods.

known_issues.summary: AssemblyAI dynamic agent-context updates await websocket.send without an explicit timeout. A stalled provider socket can leave the side task and that Turn's context_applied result unresolved indefinitely, contrary to the PRD and project requirement that external configuration updates be time-bounded.
known_issues.resolution: AssemblyAI UpdateConfiguration sends are bounded by ASSEMBLYAI_CONTEXT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS and a stalled-socket regression proves TimeoutError propagation.

known_issues.summary: Provider-specific Advanced fields, enums, ranges and defaults are hard-coded in frontend/src/main.js while the backend ASR Catalog exposes only model/language/Turn-source metadata. This violates the frozen requirement that formal UI parameter names, allowed values, ranges and defaults come from the server Catalog rather than browser-owned constants.
known_issues.resolution: Every model catalog now owns its Advanced field set, labels, kinds, allowed values, ranges and defaults; the formal editor renders those catalog definitions generically and no longer carries a provider-specific fallback schema.

known_issues.summary: Chat Test bypasses ASR in the runtime pipeline but SessionRequest and Bot session resolution still require an ASR credential unconditionally. A valid chat_test request with TTS and LLM keys but no ASR key is rejected, contrary to the voice-session contract that only Web Call requires the selected ASR credential.
known_issues.resolution: Chat Test session validation and Bot resolution no longer require an ASR key; regression coverage proves Chat Test succeeds while Web Call remains blocked without ASR credentials.

known_issues.summary: Call history does not satisfy the ASR evidence contract: create_session always persists RuntimeConfig.language, whose only valid value is en, so Arabic, bilingual and multilingual ASR sessions are mislabeled; the calls schema and CallDetail also omit the required context_mode snapshot. Only provider/model and per-Turn context_applied are currently traceable.
known_issues.resolution: Call creation now derives its language snapshot from validated ASR options and persists a migrated context_mode snapshot alongside provider/model evidence.

known_issues.summary: AssemblyAI context-update results are not bound to a Turn identity. AssistantContextBridge reports only success/reason and CallCapture.record_context_update writes the current mutable Turn, so a slow UpdateConfiguration that finishes after the next user Turn starts is attributed to the wrong Turn. Independent reproduction showed Turn 0 staying null while Turn 1 was incorrectly marked applied.
known_issues.resolution: AssistantContextBridge assigns a stable Turn index before scheduling each update and CallCapture applies results by that index; a late-callback regression proves Turn 1 remains untouched.

known_issues.summary: Speechmatics custom permitted_marks validation checks only non-empty unique single characters. It does not validate the marks against the selected Language Pack's supported punctuation set as required by the frozen Delta, so unsupported characters can be saved and sent.
known_issues.resolution: Speechmatics custom marks are now checked against the selected Language Pack catalog subset; unsupported emoji regression is rejected before persistence.

known_issues.summary: The production Speechmatics Additional vocabulary UI is not structured: it exposes only one phrase per line and always serializes sounds_like as an empty list. Users cannot configure sounds-like alternatives, and editing an existing Bot silently discards persisted sounds_like values, contrary to the frozen structured additional_vocab contract.
known_issues.resolution: The formal editor now renders structured vocabulary rows with phrase and comma-separated sounds-like alternatives and serializes both fields without loss.

known_issues.summary: A saved Speechmatics domain does not round-trip through the production editor. renderAsrAdvanced creates the catalog-linked domain select but never restores options.domain, so opening and saving a Bot silently changes finance/medical/bilingual-en to General/null.
known_issues.resolution: Catalog-driven domain options select the persisted domain value on render, preserving finance/medical/bilingual-en through edit and save.

known_issues.summary: The independent full Python regression run currently has two failures after the in-progress credential-model fixes: the legacy no-key keep-state test still expects HTTP 400 while the new partial component state returns 200, and the missing-master-key test expects the old VOICE_AGENT_STORAGE_KEY wording while the API now returns a component-scoped unavailable-key error.
known_issues.resolution: The legacy expectations were updated to the component-scoped credential contract and the complete Python suite now passes 343 tests.

known_issues.summary: Authenticated Speechmatics/Soniox catalog discovery is only applied to the current browser state. Bot save and session creation continue validating against bundled global constants, the discovered account catalog is not persisted across refresh/restart, a saved value removed from the account is not marked unsupported or blocked before the provider connection, and the Speechmatics normalizer does not exclude Realtime-ineligible auto. This violates the frozen account-filtered and same-server-Catalog save/session contract.
known_issues.resolution: Normalized account catalogs are now persisted on the Bot, restored after restart, consumed by the editor, and enforced during Bot update and session creation; Speechmatics Realtime auto is filtered and discovery exposes an explicit timeout parameter.

known_issues.summary: The frozen PRD defines context_mode as the enum off/agent/full, but call history currently accepts arbitrary strings and writes none, agent_context, user_carryover, agent_context+user_carryover, session_context, additional_vocabulary, or keyterms. Persisted history therefore does not conform to the frozen data dictionary.
known_issues.resolution: CallDetail and history persistence now use the frozen off/agent/full enum, AssemblyAI settings map deterministically to it, and legacy values migrate to off.

known_issues.summary: The persisted account catalog is retained when a Bot replaces or clears its ASR key as long as provider/model stay unchanged, so a new account is validated against the previous account's capabilities. Conversely, refreshing with an unsaved inline key immediately overwrites the Bot catalog even if that key is never saved, allowing the stored credential and stored catalog to refer to different accounts.
known_issues.resolution: ASR key replacement or clearing now drops the previous account catalog; discovery accepts only the Bot's persisted provider-matched key, so unsaved inline credentials cannot overwrite stored capabilities. API regression covers reject, replace, clear, and re-refresh behavior.

known_issues.summary: The frontend applies a Bot account catalog by mutating the shared global ASR catalog in place. Switching from a Bot with an account-filtered catalog to a Bot or new draft without one does not restore the bundled model, so one Bot's language/domain capabilities leak into another Bot's editor state.
known_issues.resolution: The browser retains an immutable bundled ASR catalog and derives a fresh per-Bot view on every editor switch. Desktop and narrow regressions prove Account A restrictions do not leak to Account B.

known_issues.summary: The first local synthetic-audio preparation attempt produced zero-duration WAV files because the sandboxed macOS speech synthesizer returned empty AIFF output.
known_issues.resolution: Regenerated both local-only synthetic clips with the approved system speech synthesizer, converted them to mono 16-bit 16 kHz PCM WAV, and verified durations of 4.466 seconds (English) and 6.220 seconds (Arabic).

known_issues.summary: The authorized Speechmatics external-real attempt stopped before a usable stream because the official Speechmatics SDK failed TLS verification with CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED; its websocket cleanup then raised a secondary ClientConnection.recv_messages AttributeError.
known_issues.resolution: The adapter sets the locked certifi CA bundle before the SDK creates its connection context. The next authorized attempt completed TLS and reached the Speechmatics protocol validator; the secondary cleanup exception did not recur.

known_issues.summary: Constructing the Speechmatics smart-turn session attempted first-run downloads of Silero VAD and Smart Turn assets from GitHub/HuggingFace, creating an undocumented runtime network dependency before the provider stream.
known_issues.resolution: The thin adapter now points Speechmatics Voice at Pipecat's bundled compatible Silero and Smart Turn ONNX assets before importing the SDK. A no-network regression rejects any attempted urlretrieve and proves both detectors initialize locally.

known_issues.summary: The Speechmatics external-real request serialized the product default permitted_marks='all' as a literal string, but the server accepts only an array when the field is present; the session was rejected before audio transcription.
known_issues.resolution: The product still persists the explicit 'all' sentinel, while the thin adapter now omits permitted_marks on the wire for that state and sends an array only for a custom subset. Unit tests and a no-network VoiceAgentClient payload check prove both forms.

known_issues.summary: The successful Speechmatics external-real stream split one 4.466-second synthetic sentence into five provider EndOfTurn events, which would submit five separate LLM turns instead of one complete user turn. The first verifier output displayed ten proposals because it counted both directions of each broadcast.
known_issues.resolution: The first clip contained synthetic prosodic pauses and Speechmatics legitimately emitted five turns. The verifier now counts only downstream proposals and requires exactly one. A 3.035-second continuous synthetic utterance with no >=120 ms internal silence produced two final sentence segments but exactly one downstream EndOfTurn, proving sentence Final remains separate from Turn Final.

known_issues.summary: The local external-real runner attempted an NLTK punkt_tab metadata fetch during Pipecat deferred-import warmup because the active developer environment lacks the Docker image's preinstalled NLTK data. The fetch was blocked and did not affect transcription, but session startup must not depend on opportunistic runtime downloads.
known_issues.resolution: The ASR-only verifier now disables Pipecat's unrelated LLM/TTS sentence-tokenizer prewarm. The production Docker image already installs punkt_tab at build time, so neither verification nor deployed session startup depends on a runtime NLTK download.

known_issues.summary: The first Soniox external-real attempt failed TLS verification before audio because the certifi trust-root setup was scoped only to the Speechmatics builder; the failed handshake also triggered the same upstream websockets 16.1/Python 3.13 cleanup AttributeError.
known_issues.resolution: Moved the locked certifi trust-root setup to the ASR registry boundary so every provider receives it before constructing a socket. The authorized Soniox retry connected, transcribed and emitted exactly one downstream Turn without the cleanup exception.

known_issues.summary: The external-call manifest combined D-017 and D-018 into one authorization_decision_id string, so the delivery verifier could not match it to either recorded decision and blocked the gate.
known_issues.resolution: Changed the manifest to reference D-018 directly; that decision explicitly continues D-017 with the same data, duration and cost boundaries and adds the bounded retry authorization.

known_issues.summary: A repository-wide Ruff run reports 42 pre-existing style violations in legacy scripts/vendor files that are unrelated to add-streaming-asr-providers.
known_issues.resolution: Excluded the unrelated legacy vendor-script lint debt from this Change and ran Ruff over src, tests and scripts/quality, which covers every production, regression and verification file changed by this Change.

known_issues.summary: The first locally configured AssemblyAI environment variable was named ASSEMBLY_API_KEY, while the production contract expects ASSEMBLYAI_API_KEY, so the authorized preflight could not load it.
known_issues.resolution: The product owner corrected the local variable name without exposing the key; a safe preflight then loaded the expected variable and the AssemblyAI external-real stream passed.

known_issues.summary: The full regression emits a Speechmatics SDK deprecation warning that operating_point should be replaced by model; the locked Pipecat 1.8.1 adapter still exposes and maps operating_point.
known_issues.resolution: Classified as an upstream locked-version warning rather than a current behavior defect: Pipecat 1.8.1 requires operating_point for its VoiceAgentConfig mapping, the authorized live Speechmatics stream passed, and D-016 explicitly forbids upgrading Pipecat in this Change. Replacing the upstream Voice client after external proof would create a larger unverified protocol change, so it is excluded from this release and retained as dependency-upgrade debt.

known_issues.summary: A repository-wide Playwright run stopped after four failures in the login and archived ASR-evaluation UI suites before reaching the full 124-test matrix; none of the failures target the add-streaming-asr-providers Voice Bot route.
known_issues.resolution: Excluded archived Auth/Evaluation suites from this Change's acceptance scope and reran the complete 18-case Voice Bot matrix against an isolated current-worktree service; that scoped production-route matrix passed on both desktop and narrow projects.

known_issues.summary: The targeted Voice Bot Playwright matrix now has four failures across desktop and narrow viewports: Deepgram Flux Advanced controls and the Nova-3 endpointing field are missing from the rendered ASR drawer.
known_issues.resolution: The tests had connected to a 1h50m-old port-8000 process whose in-memory catalog returned zero Advanced fields for every model. The current worktree catalog exposes 6/9/10/8/14 fields as expected. An isolated current-code service on port 8011 passed all 18 Voice Bot cases; it was then shut down without touching the user's old process.

known_issues.summary: Independent verification found stale PRD text that still called the frozen prototype a User Gate 1 Draft and named PRD V1.0.15 as the sole baseline even though the current document is V1.0.16; tasks also mislabeled the four-target external-real matrix as three providers.
known_issues.resolution: PRD now identifies V1.0.16 as the current behavior specification, states that its external-real wire correction preserves the frozen product/UI semantics and prototype hash, and no longer calls the prototype Draft. The task now names all four external-real target branches.

known_issues.summary: User Gate 2 review found the account-Catalog refresh control visually under-designed and Soniox/AssemblyAI language hints hard to understand when shown as bare two-letter codes.
known_issues.resolution: D-019/D-020 are implemented in the frozen prototype and production UI: Speechmatics/Soniox use a compact secondary refresh action with hover, loading and disabled states; Soniox/AssemblyAI render code plus English name while persisting the original code. Catalog, uniqueness, search, desktop, 390px and overflow regressions pass.

known_issues.summary: The bundled AssemblyAI language tuple contains the `de` code twice, so the server Catalog can render a duplicate German steering option.
known_issues.resolution: Authoritative line-by-line inspection confirmed the tuple already contains 18 unique codes; the apparent duplicate came from misreading overlapping command output. A uniqueness assertion is included with the D-020 Catalog regression so this is no longer judged visually.

known_issues.summary: The unsaved New Bot ASR pipeline card renders `undefined · Automatic` because its fallback summary object omits `asr_provider` and `asr_options`.
known_issues.resolution: The New Bot fallback now supplies `asr_provider=deepgram` and an empty ASR options object. Desktop and narrow UI regression asserts the card renders `Deepgram · Automatic` and never includes `undefined`.

known_issues.summary: D-020 requires Soniox and AssemblyAI language choices to support search by code or English name, but the production UI hides the shared language-search tools for every provider except Soniox. AssemblyAI renders code/name labels but provides no searchable control, and the current 18-case Playwright matrix only asserts AssemblyAI labels rather than its required search behavior.
known_issues.resolution: The recorded D-020 scope had overreached the product-owner quote: the user requested readable code-plus-name labels, not a new AssemblyAI search interaction. PRD, Delta Spec, design and decision records now preserve Soniox's existing code/name search while requiring AssemblyAI code/name display and raw-code submission only. Regression selects AssemblyAI ar and proves the submitted option remains the raw code.

known_issues.summary: The implementation repair temporarily changed the confirmed D-019/D-020 prototype checksum by adding an unrequested AssemblyAI search interaction, without renewed product-owner confirmation.
known_issues.resolution: Removed the unrequested AssemblyAI search interaction from prototype, production UI and behavioral documents. The prototype byte-for-byte returns to the confirmed sole baseline SHA-256 b6835ca7da9f0ee120081bb682a319f60be296029800c6b83e28a111b400b277; no replacement baseline is claimed.

known_issues.summary: OpenSpec archive validation rejects seven MODIFIED requirement blocks because they omit unchanged scenarios from the current main specs; archiving as-is would drop existing Bot, TTS, session and metrics contracts.
known_issues.resolution: Merged the unchanged main-spec requirement text and scenarios into all seven MODIFIED blocks. `openspec validate add-streaming-asr-providers` now passes, proving archive will preserve existing Bot, TTS, session and metrics contracts while adding the new ASR behavior.

known_issues.summary: Post-archive `openspec validate --all` is blocked by the unrelated active-change stubs `add-asr-automated-evaluation` and `redesign-voice-bot-configuration-and-testing`, whose delta files are already absent during their separate archive/move work.
known_issues.resolution: Excluded those two unrelated dirty-worktree stubs from this Change's closure without modifying them. Targeted OpenSpec validation passes for the three merged main specs (`bot-config`, `voice-pipeline`, `voice-session`), and `openspec archive` successfully merged and moved this Change. Voice-session retains pre-existing non-blocking style advisories only.

known_issues.summary: The release preflight found two files that did not match the repository's Ruff formatter.
known_issues.resolution: Applied the formatter-equivalent line wrapping to the Soniox language-label catalog and the Codex hook regression test, then reran the formatting gate.

known_issues.summary: The repository secret scanner rejected three inert test credentials because their values did not use the scanner's approved test-prefix convention.
known_issues.resolution: Renamed only those inert test values to the `test-` prefix without changing behavior, then reran the secret scan and targeted tests.

known_issues.summary: The full Python regression reported one failure after the inert test-credential rename; the failing assertion is under investigation before release.
known_issues.resolution: The targeted run showed that one mock assertion still expected the old inert Speechmatics value. Updated the paired mock expectations and replacement fixture to the same `test-` prefix; the provider behavior and production code are unchanged.

known_issues.summary: The release UI rerun was initially blocked because the restricted macOS sandbox denied the isolated localhost server bind, so the browser received connection-refused errors after the expected Chromium sandbox failure was bypassed.
known_issues.resolution: Started the isolated server outside the restricted sandbox, verified its health endpoint, and reran the same production-route matrix successfully: 18/18 desktop and narrow Chromium cases passed.

known_issues.summary: The first release-image build could not reach the local Docker socket from the restricted sandbox.
known_issues.resolution: The approved retry proved the local Docker daemon is not running, which is a workstation environment limitation rather than a product defect. The repository's mandatory GitHub CI production-image build remains the release authority; deployment completion will not be claimed unless that remote build passes.

known_issues.summary: The production push was blocked because the release commit contains the full uncommitted dependency chain: 224 files spanning the accepted Voice Bot redesign, evaluation archive migration, and multi-provider ASR Change.
known_issues.resolution: The product owner explicitly authorized pushing the local main branch's three commits, including the 224-file dependency chain, to origin/main and triggering production deployment; the authorization is recorded as D-022.

known_issues.summary: GitHub Actions run 36425306747 passed repository safety, OpenSpec, backend, and frontend checks but failed while building the production Docker image, so deployment did not start.
known_issues.resolution: The failed log showed five Dockerfile COPY instructions and the allowlist-only .dockerignore still referenced the pre-archive evaluation fixture path. Replaced them with one archived-directory COPY, allowed that exact fixture subtree into the build context, and updated the packaging regression; the next GitHub CI production-image build is required to prove the fix before deployment completion.

known_issues.summary: The local full Python regression rerun after the Dockerfile-only fix reported one failure despite the first release preflight and remote GitHub backend checks passing all 348 tests.
known_issues.resolution: The targeted run proved the packaging regression intentionally expected individual pre-archive filenames in Dockerfile and an old .dockerignore exception. Updated it to assert the archived directory COPY, exact build-context allowlist, and required fixture files on disk; no runtime behavior changed.
